title: eleutherococcus divaricatus var. chiisanensis
intro: Eleutherococcus divaricatus var. chiisanensis, commonly known as Korean Ginseng, is a plant species within the Araliaceae family. It is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as the potential to improve cognitive function and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be attributed to its adaptogenic properties, allowing it to help the body adapt to stress and promote overall well-being. Bioactive constituents of Korean Ginseng include ginsenosides, triterpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
